attacker_pocs.name: dfa-workspace-underallocation
attacker_pocs.why: A 4 KiB DFA recursion-workspace block is recorded at its full int capacity but allocated one KiB short; one hundred active alternation states write beyond the heap allocation through pcre2_dfa_match().

role_a_rationale: The patch fixes block-size arithmetic in 64-bit units and rejects reuse of an existing workspace block that cannot hold the requested recursion vector. Normal tests and the original deeply recursive heap-limit case now pass without the parent sanitizer abort. The remaining defect is an allocation-size arithmetic error in the newly changed workspace growth path; the supplied public-API PoC uses a valid anchored pattern, subject, heap limit, and workspace vector, and writes past the undersized block only on the patched tree.
